summary: Revision R1 applied per revision-notice.pdf p.1 and rent-roll-revised.xlsx (roll as of 2026-09-01, superseding the 2026-08-31 certified roll). Four inputs changed: Suite 045 moved from pending to active; Suite 045 scheduled rent +$225 to $2,150/mo; sizing rate +75 bps from 6.2500% to 7.0000%; cap rate +25 bps from 5.7500% to 6.0000%. All other facts are preserved unchanged - 48 units / 40,800 SF, A/B/C = Studio/1BR/2BR, all expirations 2029-08-31, Suite 001 executed +$350 amendment (in-place $1,850), T12 statement and reported NOI $604,128, 5% loss, $350/unit other income, prescribed expense lines, 3% management, $300/unit reserves, 65% LTV / 1.25x DSCR / 9% debt yield, 30-yr amortization, 1% fee, $45,000 closing costs, $4,200,000 payoff, $2,000,000 GL policy limit, incomplete legal/environmental/PCA/title diligence. Revised results: occupancy 45/48 units (0.9375) and 38,250/40,800 SF (0.9375), no pending units; annual in-place rent $920,400; GPR $977,100; EGI $945,045; NOI before reserves $643,862; NCF $629,462; capitalization value $10,731,028; LTV limit $6,975,168, DSCR limit $6,307,523, debt yield limit $6,994,018, maximum loan $6,307,523 (DSCR binding); net cash-out $1,999,448 with no shortfall. Versus the initial package, maximum loan falls $481,022 and net cash-out falls $476,212, driven by the 75 bp sizing-rate increase, while value falls $423,296 as the 25 bp cap-rate expansion outweighs +$2,488 of NOI. Deliverables created: artifacts/underwriting-v2.xlsx (Revision Log, Rent Roll, Underwriting, Debt, Sensitivity, Sources; live formulas) and artifacts/memorandum-v3.pdf (8-page revised OM). The initial underwriting-v1.xlsx and memorandum-v2.pdf are retained in the audit archive and were not replaced. The approved sentence is preserved exactly in both revised deliverables: "Source-backed analysis. Assumptions remain subject to diligence." No photos, asking price, market comps or sponsor history exist in the packet; these remain explicitly unknown.
qualifications: Prior deliverables (underwriting-v1.xlsx, memorandum-v2.pdf) remain in the audit archive; the revision adds underwriting-v2.xlsx and memorandum-v3.pdf rather than overwriting them.
Approved manager copy preserved verbatim: "Source-backed analysis. Assumptions remain subject to diligence."

Underwritten gross potential rent is the prescribed all-unit scheduled rent on the revised roll ($81,425/mo x 12 = $977,100); it is not current contractual in-place rent, which is $920,400 on the 45 occupied suites including the Suite 001 amendment.

The Suite 045 status change and +$225 increase are supported only by the certified revision notice and revised roll; underlying lease documentation for possession date and the increase is not in the packet.

risk_pending_in_occupancy is now absent because the revised roll shows zero pending units and 45 genuinely active suites; the manager's earlier inclusion of an unpossessed pending unit at the 2026-08-31 date was assessed present in the initial package and is documented in the Revision Log.

Loan is sized on the amortizing 30-year payment at the revised 7.0000% rate even though the first 24 months are interest-only; actual early-period cash debt service would be lower. The 6.0000% floor is non-binding since it is below both the 6.2500% note rate and the 7.0000% directed sizing rate.
Historical T12 NOI ($604,128, cash basis before management fee and reserves), revised underwritten NOI ($643,862) and NCF ($629,462) are different definitions and are labeled separately.
Asking price, photographs, market sale/rent comparables, sponsor history, capital budget and tax/insurance renewal quotes are not supplied - explicitly unknown, not zero.

Legal, environmental, property condition and title reviews remain incomplete (diligence-status.pdf p.1); these are routine pending items and no defect, contamination, litigation or fraud finding is asserted.
Capitalization value is an income-approach indication from the directed cap rate only, uncorroborated by market comparables.
